class.name: OcgXscontrolWriter
class.brief_description: This class gives a simple way to create then write a Model compliant to a given norm, from a Shape The model can then be edited by tools by other appropriate tools
class.description: ! This class gives a simple way to create then write a ! Model compliant to a given norm, from a Shape ! The model can then be edited by tools by other appropriate tools

method.name: from_char_const_ptr
method.description: Creates a Writer from scratch, with a norm name which identifie a Controller

method.name: SetNorm
method.description: Sets a specific norm to <me> Returns True if done, False if <norm> is not available

method.name: Model
method.description: Returns the produced model. Produces a new one if not yet done or if <newone> is True This method allows for instance to edit product or header data before writing

method.name: TransferShape
method.description: Transfers a Shape according to the mode
